title: Query-Driven Domain Leakage
pattern: Business definitions and rules (e.g., who qualifies as an "active user") are embedded entirely inside SQL queries or database views, rather than inside the domain objects.
why_bad: It dilutes the domain model, turning entities into mere data containers. Changes to business rules require finding and refactoring SQL strings, which are often not checked by compile-time type systems.
detection: SQL string literals or query builders contain complex conditional criteria filtering on business states or calculations.
counterexample: Simple identity or primary-key lookups where database retrieval is purely mechanical and carries no business evaluation.
